candidate_structure.information_flow: The probe alone receives the six common inputs. Its complete evidence state is visible to and consumed by the rebase call; the complete transitioned state is then visible to and consumed by the final materializer. There are no parallel paths, bypasses, or unconsumed outputs.
candidate_structure.name: Interventional Responsibility Rebase Lineage
candidate_structure.organization: Three-node sequential causal-state lineage with one probe, one state transformer, and one post-transition materializer.

calls.objective: Using only the supplied inputs, establish one causal non-separability witness at an inherited responsibility boundary by relating the candidate hypothesis to distinct contract obligations while holding unrelated responsibilities fixed. Emit the evidenced boundary and current construction state.

Consume responsibility_probe and let its non-separability witness trigger a change from anchor-relative repair state to contract-relative joint-responsibility state at the evidenced boundary. Preserve unaffected obligations and evidence provenance, then emit the transitioned construction state.

Consume responsibility_rebase and realize its transitioned causal organization as exactly one complete contract-compliant policy while retaining its visible evidence obligations and authoritative-state constraints.

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion cannot leave its anchor-relative delta coordinate system when an inherited responsibility simultaneously supports one obligation and causes another obligation's failure.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This changes the model class and causal control regime; no call reviews, certifies, gates, renames, or subdivides the champion's existing producer duties.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: The final producer receives a rebased causal model in which the implicated obligations can be realized through a newly organized shared responsibility rather than compensating edits around the inherited decomposition.
mode_certificate.state_transition: The construction state changes from anchor-relative delta repair to contract-relative joint-responsibility synthesis at the evidenced causal boundary, with unaffected responsibilities preserved.
mode_certificate.trigger: A counterfactual responsibility probe establishes non-separability: suppressing the inherited cause implicated by the candidate hypothesis closes one obligation only by reopening a distinct protected obligation while unrelated responsibilities remain fixed.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Introduce one evidence-triggered causal-responsibility rebase that changes the construction state from anchor-relative repair to contract-relative joint-responsibility synthesis before policy materialization.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: When inherited responsibility boundaries cause lock-in, the transitioned state makes a task-general causal organization reachable without accumulating compensating anchor-relative edits.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion can add, reverse, and compress anchor-relative deltas, but it remains inside the anchor's inherited responsibility decomposition when distinct contract obligations are causally entangled.

structural_mutation.after: A three-call directed lineage establishes causal non-separability, rebases the implicated responsibility model, and materializes one policy from the transitioned state.
structural_mutation.before: One terminal producer performs anchor-relative reversible repair and terminal causal compression without changing the inherited responsibility model.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The added capability changes the design representation and reachable causal organization in response to evidence; it is not terminal role fission, review, certification, or pre-mutation evidence precommitment.

receipt.role: score-blind R3 emergent_exploration structure architect; never policy code
